name: Spawn Actor from Class
description: Instantiates a new actor of the supplied class at the specified world-space transform at runtime. Returns a reference to the spawned actor, or null if the spawn failed (for example due to collision).

inputs.name: Class
inputs.description: The class of actor to instantiate. Connect a class reference set in a variable or picked from the dropdown.

inputs.name: Transform
inputs.description: The world-space transform to place the actor at. Expand the pin to feed Location, Rotation, and Scale separately.

inputs.name: Collision Handling Override
inputs.description: Determines how collisions are handled at the spawn point. Use AdjustIfPossibleButAlwaysSpawn to force the spawn regardless of overlaps.

inputs.name: Owner
inputs.description: Optional owning actor for the spawned instance. Used for replication, kill credit, and damage routing.

outputs.name: Out
outputs.description: Execution pin that fires after the spawn attempt completes. Continue the graph from here.

outputs.name: Spawned Actor
outputs.description: Reference to the spawned actor, or null if spawn failed. Always validate this with Is Valid before use.
